aboutText: Plumbistry is your dedicated local plumber servicing Strathmore and Melbourne's northern suburbs. We specialise in keeping your home or business safe with thorough rental checks, fixing persistent roof and gutter leaks, and installing reliable hot water systems. With a commitment to clear communication and quality workmanship, we're the team Strathmore trusts for all plumbing needs.
servicesText: From essential safety inspections to urgent leak repairs and new installations, Plumbistry provides a comprehensive range of plumbing services for Strathmore residents and businesses.
